text: Done as cross-implementation evidence (never labelled native): X5 at 044b0f15 (x5/, nitransforms 25.1.0, lattice points; nitransforms interpolates dense fields off-grid with cubic B-splines) and ITK/FLIRT/AFNI at 4fcb3176 (nitransforms_crosscheck/, 8 asymmetric points per file; JVM+JS agree to 1e-5). Findings recorded: nitransforms reads only plain ITK AffineTransform files; it centres volumes lacking qform and sform (FSL/image4s/ScalaFIM use origin scaling), so flirt_4_to_2 is excluded with that reason; nitransforms writes LTAs with the reference geometry in the src slot (inverted under FreeSurfer semantics, see P3.06).
